title: Kanjilink: learn Japanese kanji on your lock screen
description:
Learn a Japanese kanji every time you look at your phone.

Kanjilink puts one kanji on your lock screen, in a home-screen widget and in a gentle notification every few hours. Each kanji shows its meaning and its on and kun readings, with romaji, so you can start from zero.

• Spaced repetition: tap "I know it" and it comes back tomorrow, tap "Again" and it comes back in 10 minutes
• 2,211 kanji from JLPT N5 to N1
• JLPT N5 is free; Kanjilink Pro unlocks N4 to N1 with one payment, no subscription
• No account, no ads, your progress stays on your phone

Get it on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.vplusstudio.kanjilink
Website: https://kanjilink.vplusstudio.app
